stem: Anita carried out a survey of 140 randomly selected students at her college. She found that 49 of these students watched a TV programme called *Bunch*.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Calculate an approximate 98% confidence interval for the proportion, $p$, of students at Anita’s college who watch *Bunch*.

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem: Carlos says that the confidence interval found in **(a)** is not useful because it is too wide.
parts.text: Without calculation, explain briefly how Carlos can use the results of Anita’s survey to find a narrower confidence interval for $p$.
